name: Baseline day
expected: Feasible plan or explicit infeasibility; enforce stock, supplier and cash constraints

name: Biscuit demand spike
trigger: Increase biscuit demand by 60 percent for two simulated days
expected: Recompute stock and orders; show unmet demand and replan

name: Supplier delay
trigger: Delay one supplier by two days; balance date unknown
expected: Compare alternatives; do not invent a revised date

name: Liquidity stress
trigger: Delay a 3000000-paise retailer payment by seven days
expected: Protect the 5000000-paise minimum buffer or report infeasible

name: Inventory discrepancy
trigger: Physical count finds 15 fewer base units for one SKU

name: Retailer complaint
trigger: Late delivery complaint with product mention but no order ID
expected: Preserve exact evidence and request clarification for unmatched order

name: Competitor report
expected: Show as reported/unverified, not as established market fact

name: Combined disruption
trigger: Demand increase, supplier delay and delayed payment together
expected: Replan under hard constraints or explain infeasibility
